title: Concept: Published crate replaced by another source at build time
description: Cargo.toml declares a `[patch.crates-io]` section that swaps a published crate, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `[patch.crates-io]` section that swaps a published crate.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `[patch.crates-io]` section that swaps a published crate.
